title: The 1997 Nobel citation: prions as a principle of infection
summary: The Nobel Foundation credits Stanley Prusiner with the discovery of prions, which the citation calls a new biological principle of infection.
body: The Nobel Prize API record for 1997 says Stanley B. Prusiner received the prize in physiology or medicine for his discovery of prions, which the motivation calls a new biological principle of infection. The record dates the award 6 October 1997. The card repeats the citation. It does not add a protein-folding mechanism the motivation sentence does not state.

sources.title: The Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine 1997
sources.author: Nobel Foundation
sources.note: Motivation text was read from the Nobel Prize API record.
